captions.story: Deep beneath the ocean floor lies a frozen moment in history guarded by toxic gas.

story.series: What Lies at the Bottom of the Great Blue Hole?
story.summary: This episode explores the Great Blue Hole in Belize, explaining how it transitioned from an Ice Age cave to a flooded sinkhole, featuring its toxic hydrogen sulfide layer and preserved ancient stalactites.

title: What Lies at the Bottom of the Great Blue Hole?
